verification_policy: Batched readability workflow: exact token substitution for alpha-only edits; review event routing, callback order and live/cached reads for structured edits. One target build per batch. Native comparisons reserved for uncertain behavior; reccmp refresh deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability reconstruction of existing War of the Spark card handlers and helpers. No new native-function coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim. Preserve native quirks, repeated queries, context reads and opaque dialogs.
review_notes: Forty-three alpha-only definitions preserve exact tokens after declared local renames. Seventeen structured definitions use source review and one target build; no new native semantic comparisons.
Keep untargetability/ETB and EOT ordering, aura attachment/death reads, owner/IID capture and delayed reanimation setup.

Keep Cruel Celebrant, Liliana and Mayhem death eligibility differences, detach flag byte offsets, source-death early return, low-byte counts, status checks, and per-trigger life/damage/target cleanup order.
Keep static legacy detection, fresh active-card bounds, validation-driven mode reloads and possible later exile resolution after destruction callbacks.
Keep Nahiri loyalty/toughness checks, Sarkhan attacker and dragon scans, Tolsimir ETB/fight behavior, Sorin dynamic AI loyalty queries and grave selection even after failed payment.
Keep two-target damage/mill/amass behavior, Lazotep live permanent scan, and Vivien AI/human predicate setup, timing, payment and hand-card dispatch. Opaque dialogs remain out of scope.
The final five larger routines receive structured source review, one build and the combined current reccmp refresh; no new native semantic cases are claimed.
Mana discount preserves unsigned wrapping/clamping, Reaper King handling, fixed/X and artifact cost routing, hybrid/phyrexian queries, temporary-card invisibility/hand-count ordering and cleanup.
Casualties retains cast-time target marking, per-target mode metadata and fresh type-mask reads after every validation, with destruction after all eligible type checks.
Liliana retains duplicate-legacy detection, death collection, kill-state eligibility, draw queries, activation record refresh, sacrifice order and opponent selection/unmarking.

Citadel retains human/AI availability differences, cached versus live library top reads, life costs, incomplete selection rollback, full unmarking and final sacrifice order (including native fizzle writes).

Planewide retains packed-byte choice updates and grouped resolution: initial grave validation, Citizens, grave returns, proliferation, then life. Keep callback-sensitive mode snapshots and the early validation-failure exit without basic_spell.
status: All 65 War of the Spark definitions applied. Final target build and combined reccmp refresh follow.
